outputs.answer: All refund requests are processed within 30 business days of receipt through the official portal.[p01]

Customers are responsible for return shipping costs for non-defective items.[p03] If the item is defective, HariOm provides a prepaid return shipping label.[p03]
Refunds are issued to the original payment method.[p04] Credit card refunds take 5-10 additional business days to appear on statements after processing.[p04]
